queen-mate.title: King and queen against king
queen-mate.intro: Goal: deliver checkmate. Use the queen to shut the enemy king into an ever smaller cage, then bring your own king closer. Watch out for stalemate!
rook-mate.title: King and rook against king
rook-mate.intro: Goal: deliver checkmate. The rook cuts off the ranks and the king helps it: push the enemy king toward the edge together.
king-pawn.title: King and pawn against king
king-pawn.intro: Goal: promote the pawn. Bring your king in front of the pawn and take the opposition: the pawn only gets to the end if your king opens the way.
lucena.title: The Lucena position
lucena.intro: Goal: promote the pawn. Your king is shut in front of the pawn: drive the enemy king away with the rook, then build the “bridge” to shield yourself from checks.
philidor.title: The Philidor defense
philidor.intro: Goal: don't lose for {par} moves. You play Black: keep the rook on the sixth rank until the pawn advances, then bring it to the back and check from behind.
bishop-knight.title: Bishop and knight
bishop-knight.intro: Goal: deliver checkmate. It's the hardest checkmate: drive the enemy king toward a corner of your bishop's color. You have 50 moves before the game is a draw.
